description: This PHP file defines the ListView class used in the SuiteCRM (a SugarCRM derivative) project. It manages list view rendering, including pagination, sorting, and list data processing for CRM entities. The class includes methods for processing list views based on SugarBean objects, handling list navigation, and managing template rendering through XTemplate.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: The ListView class manages rendering and interaction logic for list views in SuiteCRM, encompassing pagination, sorting, processing data from SugarBean objects, and template assignment through XTemplate.

methods.name: setDataArray
methods.description: Sets the data array for processing in list view rendering.

methods.name: processListViewMulti
methods.description: Processes and renders a multi-select list view, including mass update form handling.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Renders the main list view, including handling sorting, pagination, mass update, and list data processing.

methods.name: process_dynamic_listview
methods.description: Processes dynamic list views, often used for subpanels or related module displays.

methods.name: process_dynamic_listview_rows
methods.description: Handles rendering of each row in a dynamic list view, assigning data to the XTemplate output.

methods.name: setDisplayHeaderAndFooter
methods.description: Controls whether the header and footer HTML are included in output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ListView object, setting default parameters from configuration.

methods.name: setRecordsPerPage
methods.description: Sets how many records should be displayed per page.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title for the list view.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Sets additional header text, usually for buttons or instructions.

methods.name: setXTemplatePath
methods.description: Specifies the path for the XTemplate HTML template used for rendering.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes a new XTemplate object with specified template path, language strings, and image path.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Retrieves sorting order and field based on session, request, and default.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Assigns WHERE clause, limit, and ORDER BY clause for list data retrieval.

methods.name: displayArrow
methods.description: Placeholder for displaying sorting arrows in UI (currently empty).

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets UI theme and updates template assignments.

methods.name: setAppStrings
methods.description: Sets application language strings for use in templates.

methods.name: setModStrings
methods.description: Sets module-specific language strings.

methods.name: setImagePath
methods.description: Sets the image path used in templates.

methods.name: setCurrentModule
methods.description: Sets the current module name for context in templates.

methods.name: createXTemplate
methods.description: Creates and initializes the XTemplate object for rendering.

methods.name: setXTemplate
methods.description: Assigns a pre-initialized XTemplate object.

methods.name: getXTemplate
methods.description: Returns the current XTemplate object.

methods.name: xTemplateAssign
methods.description: Assigns a variable to the XTemplate.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the current pagination offset, resetting if the query has changed.

methods.name: setOffset
methods.description: Sets the pagination offset for list view.

methods.name: setSessionVariable
methods.description: Stores a variable in the session scoped to the current module.

methods.name: setUserVariable
methods.description: Stores a preference for the current user.

methods.name: getSessionVariable
methods.description: Retrieves a variable from session scoped to the module.

methods.name: getUserVariable
methods.description: Retrieves a user preference.

methods.name: calculateSortOrder
methods.description: Determines the sort order (‘asc’ or ‘desc’) based on priority: request, session, metadata, default.

methods.name: getSessionVariableName
methods.description: Constructs and returns the session key name for storing variables.

methods.name: processSugarBean
methods.description: Processes and renders a list of SugarBean objects, supporting pagination and sorting.

methods.name: processUnionBeans
methods.description: Processes and retrieves union related list data, typically for subpanels with multi-entity relations.

methods.name: getBaseURL
methods.description: Constructs the base URL for pagination and sorting links.

methods.name: processListNavigation
methods.description: Generates pagination controls (next, previous, start, end) and navigation links.
